descriptionHtml:
"HERSTORY" is a panel discussion organized by IEEE WIE  Affinity Group of  University of Peradeniya  with regard to the International Women in Engineering Day 2021, will be carried out with the panelists:

=> Eng. (Mrs.) Kumuduni Herath - General Manager - Ceylon Electricity Board 
=> Eng. (Mrs.) Ishari Siriwardane - General Manager of Digital Projects - Sri Lanka Telecom 
=> Ms. Chathurangi Edussuriya  - Software Engineer - Sysco LABS Sri Lanka

 The main objective of this online event is to inspire and empower Women in Engineering to find their path from dreams to success.
